title: Works Sort Of
text: Works Sort Of. This is just OK. I tried some rosemary the other night and it works, but you have to pull against the leaves and not with them to get them off. The direction they show in the picture doesn't work at all.

product_metadata.title: Chef'n ZipStrip Herb Stripper, Updated Design, Green
features: QUICKLY STRIP HERBS FROM THE STEM: With one simple motion, this kitchen gadget quickly and easily removes all the herb leaves from the stem.
WORKS WITH A VARIETY OF HERBS: The different sized holes on the herb stripper allow you to strip a variety of fresh herbs, including rosemary, thyme, oregano, or tarragon.
MEASUREMENTS ON SIDE: Convenient measurement marks on the side of the cup - 1 tablespoon, 2 tablespoons, 3 tablespoons, and 1/4 cup - make prepping herbs for your recipe even easier.
CATCH EVERY LEAF: As the herb leaves are stripped from the stem, they are collected in the cup so you can keep your prep area tidy and not lose a single leaf.
EASY TO CLEAN: Top-rack dishwasher safe.
description: Make quick work of stripping herbs. The Chef'n ZipStrip easily strips, collects and measures herbs. Four separate sized holes fit any woody, stemmed herbs like rosemary, thyme and tarragon. Simply inserts the herb, root first, into the appropriate sized hold and pull through. Leaves will collect in the integrated bowl and measuring cup. Measurement sizes include: 1-Tbsp, 2-Tbsp, 3-Tbsp and 1/4 cup. For fans of the metric system, sizes also in milliliters: 15-ml, 30-ml, 45-ml and 60-ml. Top-rack dishwasher safe. HOW TO USE: Insert stem into desired hole, root first. Pull through hole. Place in top-rack of dishwasher to clean. Chef.
